decisions: Result requires a conversation at/after since and same tenant/order; EXISTS prevents duplicates with dense histories. Sort created DESC,id ASC, page limit 1..1000. Fixture includes empty conversations, tied creation timestamps and 80% dominant tenant.
assumptions: Synthetic fixture policy frozen for the narrowed slice, not invented user approval for production.
pending: H2 is not PostgreSQL; PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE, production cardinality estimates, index lock duration, latency/SLO and connection pooling remain unmeasured. Counter covers search SQL, excludes fixture loading and EXPLAIN.
approval_status: No external policy owner consultation claimed
